answer_1.quote: News summarization is the task of automatically converting news articles into concise summaries that correctly convey the main information of the articles.
answer_1.outputs: Summaries (abstractive and extractive) of news articles

answer_2.quote: We use the following metrics for factual consistency: (i) Entity precision ... (ii) BERTScore-Precision ... (iii) Quotation exact match ... Coverage: BERTScore-Recall ... Title-title similarity ... Summary-title similarity ... Abstractiveness: MINT and Simhash ... We also add SEAHORSE metrics ... Attribution, Comprehensible, MainIdea, Density.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human annotation, focused on three aspects: (i) factual consistency where the summary has no factual errors ... (ii) informativeness where the summary express the main points ... (iii) coherence where the summary has good structure and flow ... We always assign three qualified annotators for each task and use their median as the final rating.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate summaries on factual consistency (no error, minor error, major error), informativeness (1–5 stars from very poor to very good), and coherence (1–5 stars). Detailed star definitions and required explanations are provided in the annotation guidelines.
